Discover sophisticated living in this brand-new 1-bedroom apartment located in the prestigious Palace Residences North at Dubai Creek Harbour. Designed with elegance and comfort in mind, this residence offers a modern layout, quality finishes, and peaceful community views in one of Dubai’s most sought-after waterfront destinations.

Perfect for professionals or couples, the apartment combines contemporary interiors with a vibrant lifestyle surrounded by promenades, dining, and leisure attractions.
